---
title: "Guide to functions and data"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(parlcat2Rep)
parl_download(quiet = TRUE)
```

## Functions

| Group | Function | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Speeches | `parl_speeches()` | One row per speech, with filters. |
| | `parl_sessions()` | One row per session: date, speeches, words, chair. |
| | `parl_persons()` | One row per speaker, with counts with and without chairing. |
| Text | `parl_search()` | Speeches containing a word, phrase or regular expression. |
| | `parl_kwic()` | Each occurrence with its context. |
| | `parl_trend()`, `parl_plot_trend()` | Occurrences per million words by month or year, by party or side. |
| | `parl_as_corpus()`, `parl_tidy()` | Conversion to `quanteda` and `tidytext`. |
| Government | `parl_government_on()` | Government and parties in office on a date. |
| | `parl_add_government()` | Adds `govern` and `es_govern` to any table with `data` and `party_data`. |
| Reference | `parl_mps()`, `parl_parties()`, `parl_governments()`, `parl_offices()`, ... | The reference tables of the dataset. |
| Utilities | `parl_download()`, `parl_cache_dir()`, `parl_cache_clear()`, `parl_use_sample()` | Text download and cache. |
| | `parl_metadata()`, `parl_party_colors()` | Key figures and party colours. |

## Filters of `parl_speeches()`

| Argument | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `year` | 1932, 1933, 1934, 1936, 1937, 1938 | all |
| `from`, `to` | dates | all |
| `person` | full name, `id_persona` or a fragment of the name | all |
| `party` | acronyms of `party_data` | all |
| `session` | session identifiers | all |
| `side` | `"all"`, `"government"`, `"opposition"` | `"all"` |
| `office` | `TRUE`, `FALSE`, headings or labels from `parl_offices()` | no filter |
| `spoken_only` | drop readings by the secretary and anonymous headings | `TRUE` |
| `include_chair` | keep speeches made while chairing the session | `TRUE` |
| `include_doubtful` | keep speeches flagged in `assignacio_dubtosa` | `TRUE` |
| `text` | include the `text` column | `TRUE` |

```{r}
parl_speeches(side = "opposition", from = "1936-03-01", to = "1936-07-31",
              include_chair = FALSE, text = FALSE)
```

## Variables

Column names are in Catalan, as in the published dataset and its codebook.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `any`, `sessio`, `data`, `ordre`, `pagina` | Year, session, date, position in the session, PDF page. |
| `orador_cru`, `orador`, `acotacio` | Speaker heading as written, normalised, and its annotation. |
| `es_carrec`, `es_anonim` | Heading is an office / has no specific person. |
| `nom_sencer`, `id_persona`, `es_diputat` | Identified person and whether an elected MP. |
| `carrec` | Office in which the person speaks. |
| `party` | Party of the 1932 ticket (never changes). |
| `party_data` | **Party on the date of the speech**: use this one. |
| `resolucio` | How the person was identified. |
| `assignacio_dubtosa` | Attribution with a known limitation (304 speeches). |
| `n_car`, `te_taula`, `text` | Length, presence of a table, text. |
| `paraules`, `mes` | *Added by the package*: words and month. |
| `govern`, `es_govern` | *Added*: government in office and whether `party_data` was in it. |
| `circumscripcio` | *Added*: electoral district of MPs. |

## Reference tables

```{r}
parl_governments()[, c("govern", "data_inici", "data_fi", "partits")]
```

| Function | Content |
|---|---|
| `parl_mps()` | The 83 MPs elected in 1932, with district and heading forms. |
| `parl_parties()` | Party acronyms, names and notes. |
| `parl_parties_by_year()` | MPs and government status per year and party. |
| `parl_governments()` | Governments of the Generalitat and their parties. |
| `parl_ministers()` | Ministers (*consellers*) of each government, one row per minister. |
| `parl_offices()` | Holders of the offices that speak in the *Diari*, with a harmonised label (`carrec`) and the heading forms (`variants_capcalera`). |
| `parl_party_changes()` | Dated party changes (PNRE, PSUC). |
| `parl_chairs()` | Who chairs each session, from which speech. |
| `parl_aliases()` | Headings resolved by hand (spellings, homonyms, OCR errors). |
| `parl_review_cases()` | Doubtful cases and the decisions taken. |

parl_party_colors()
